title: Interactive Al Alignment: Specification, Process, and Evaluation Alignment
reasoning: The paper introduces a framework for user-centered interactive AI alignment (specification, process, and evaluation alignment) and applies it to case studies. While it acknowledges broader AI alignment concerns like 'moral values' in related work on 'pluralistic alignment', the paper explicitly states its focus is distinct from evaluating or benchmarking these aspects, instead concentrating on interface design for interactive alignment.
